Please use the app respectfully.

Helping Hand connects people who want to help with people who need a hand, in their own neighbourhood. Volunteers meet people in the street, with their consent, and list what would help. Patrons bring an item, pay for it or give towards a bigger goal, and the person confirms that they received it.
Made for IMC, built with Kotlin Multiplatform by JetBrains.

Almost all of this app is written once, in Kotlin Multiplatform, and runs on Android, desktop and the web. Only a few small things are platform-specific: the live map, the device location, the saved settings and the language switch.
All optional. Only you choose what to share.
Choosing a picture is not available on this device.
IMC supports charities around the world, with a strong focus on education and on giving young people better opportunities.
In Amsterdam, IMC's foundation has supported the IMC Weekend School since 1998. IMC also backs Room to Read, which helps children learn to read, in Africa and India.
IMC reports that its charitable giving reached almost EUR 30 million in 2025, shared among more than 200 organisations.
JetBrains was founded in 2000 in Prague. It builds the tools developers use every day, such as the IntelliJ IDEA code editor.
JetBrains created Kotlin and made it open source in 2012. Kotlin is widely used for Android apps.
This app uses Kotlin Multiplatform, which lets one codebase run on Android, desktop and the web.
